import pathlib, sys, json, hashlib
sys.path.insert(0, "tools")
from wallcrack import compile_c, extract
from modules import modules, read_bytes
import linkcheck, reloc_audit
path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
obj, error = compile_c(text, lang_cpp=text.startswith("//cpp"), version="2004/b56")
if error:
    raise SystemExit(error)
name = "func_0202ffec"
code, relocs = extract(obj, name)
module = next(m for m in modules() if m["name"] == "main")
target = read_bytes(module, 0x0202ffec, 472)
result = linkcheck.linkcheck(name, 0x0202ffec, 472, "arm9",
                             reloc_audit.build_name_index(), obj=obj, sym=name)
print(json.dumps({"compiler": "2004/b56", "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  "emitted_size": len(code), "relocation_count": len(relocs),
                  "word_diff_offsets": [hex(i) for i in range(0, min(len(code),len(target)),4)
                                        if code[i:i+4] != target[i:i+4]],
                  "pinned_link_result": result}, indent=2))
